items.title: November 23, 1996: New Jersey's Robert Pack had 17 points & 22 assists, and teammate Shawn Bradley blocked 10 shots in the Nets' 114-91 win over Dallas.
items.author: NBA Cobwebs
items.body_excerpt:
November 23, 1996: New Jersey's Robert Pack had 17 points & 22 assists, and teammate Shawn Bradley blocked 10 shots in the Nets' 114-91 win over Dallas.

Kendall Gill of the Nets scored a game-high 26 PTS (10-17 FG/4-6 3P). Jason Kidd had 10 PTS/12 AST for the Mavs.

quote.author: Blake Murphy
quote.text:
RJ Barrett will miss at least two weeks with a mild right hamstring strain.

Collin Murray-Boyles has been placed in concussion protocol, with timeline to return based on league’s symptom-free activity progressions.

items.title: November 18, 1995: New Jersey rookie Ed O'Bannon dunks on Philadelphia's Shawn Bradley during a 95-79 win over the 76ers.
items.author: NBA Cobwebs
items.body_excerpt:
November 18, 1995: New Jersey rookie Ed O'Bannon dunks on Philadelphia's Shawn Bradley during a 95-79 win over the 76ers.

O'Bannon scored 10 PTS off the bench and Armon Gilliam had 24 PTS/12 REB for the Nets. Clarence Weatherspoon had 17 PTS/10 REB for the Sixers.

items.title: Hollander POTD Steve Kuberski aka The Polish Powerhouse. 52nd pick from Bradley in 69 was a solid bench guy for BOS. Peaked at 9.3 ppg in 70-71.   for hustle. Lost in 74 expansion, he was reacquired by BOS in 76. Retired in 78. Per bio "likes country music."
